description: A semantic QC handoff for human review (CF-WO-P1-005, WO §9). Semantic checks (character continuity, face drift, lip-sync quality, physical realism, creative intent) need a real qualified reviewer or a human. This handoff names the artifacts and the checks; it is never auto-approved and never auto-passed. Only a named human reviewer may set status approved or rejected; reviewer automated is refused. Optional fields are omitted when absent, never explicit null.

checks_required.description: Semantic checks the reviewer must perform.

decision.description: The reviewer's decision; omitted while awaiting review.

note.description: Reviewer note, when one was left; omitted otherwise.

reviewer.description: Who must review (human) or did review (named human). Never automated.
